text:
### Scenario 2: Bank-Initiated (Policy Violation)  
```
Customer: Suspected unauthorized use, investigation underway

Day 1:
- Account frozen immediately (fraud hold)
- Investigation initiated by Financial Crime team
- Customer notified of freeze (no reason disclosed—tipping off risk)

Days 2–7:
- Investigation completed
- Unauthorized transactions confirmed
- Refund processed to customer
- Account closure decision made

Day 8:
- Notice sent to customer: "Account closure due to policy violation"
- 30-day notice period begins

Day 38:
- 30 days passed
- Final balance transferred (minus any chargebacks)
- Account officially closed
- Records archived

Result: ✅ Closed after 30-day notice, customer refunded
```

raw_entities.description: Bank-initiated account closure procedure triggered by suspected unauthorized use and policy violation. context: Notice sent to customer: 'Account closure due to policy violation'

raw_entities.description: On Day 38, after 30-day notice period expires, final account balance is transferred to customer, minus any chargebacks or outstanding claims.

raw_entities.name: Account Official Closure
raw_entities.description: Account is officially closed on Day 38 after 30-day notice period and final balance transfer. Account status is updated to closed in system.

raw_entities.description: Closed account records are archived on Day 38 for regulatory retention and audit purposes.
